name: connector-sfmc
description: Salesforce Marketing Cloud ENGAGEMENT (formerly ExactTarget) — not Marketing Cloud Next, Pardot, Intelligence or Personalization. Dual transport: the SOAP partner API (Retrieve/ContinueRequest) and the REST API, chosen per object from metadata. 225 objects / 3,786 fields — subscribers, lists, Data Extensions, sends and triggered sends, automations, journeys, tracking events, assets, accounts. OAuth2 client-credentials via an Installed Package; base URIs come from the token response, never baked.
